def reschedule_task(task_id: int, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task | None:
    """Move a task's due date to `due_in_seconds` seconds from now.

    Raises ValueError if the new due date is already in the past.
    """
    new_due = time.time() + due_in_seconds
    if new_due < time.time():
        raise ValueError("due date must not be in the past")
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.due_at = new_due
            save_all(tasks)
            return t
    return None


def add_tags(task_id: int, tags: list[str]) -> Task | None:
    """Attach tags to a task."""
    p_res = sub.add_parser("reschedule")
    p_res.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_res.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    p_tag = sub.add_parser("tag")
    p_tag.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_tag.add_argument("tags", nargs="+")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(a.title, a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "archive":
        print("archived" if archive_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "export":
        text = json.dumps(export_tasks(), indent=2)
        if a.out:
            with open(a.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write(text)
        else:
            print(text)
    elif a.cmd == "reschedule":
        try:
            t = reschedule_task(a.id, a.due_in)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise SystemExit(f"error: {e}")
        print(f"task {t.id} now due_at={t.due_at}" if t else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "tag":
        t = add_tags(a.id, a.tags)
        print(f"task {t.id} tags: {', '.join(t.tags)}" if t else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
    assert "keep" in out and "secret" not in out


def test_add_keeps_emails_in_title(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("Call jane.doe@acme.example about the renewal", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert t.title == "Call jane.doe@acme.example about the renewal"
    assert load_all()[0].title == t.title


def test_reschedule_rejects_past_due_date(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pytest
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("x", due_in_seconds=60)
    original = load_all()[0].due_at
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        reschedule_task(t.id, -5)
    assert load_all()[0].due_at == original


def test_cli_reschedule_past_exits_nonzero(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pytest
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("x", due_in_seconds=60)
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.argv", ["tinytasks", "reschedule", str(t.id), "--due-in", "-5"])
    from tinytasks.cli import main
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as e:
        main()
    assert e.value.code not in (0, None)


def test_tags_stored_lowercase_and_deduplicated(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("tagged", due_in_seconds=60)
    add_tags(t.id, ["Urgent", "urgent", "Work"])
    assert load_all()[0].tags == ["urgent", "work"]
